name: nested-forloop
template: {% for a in collections.rt %}[{{ forloop.Counter }}{% if forloop.First %}F{% endif %}{% if forloop.Last %}L{% endif %}:{% for b in collections.rt %}({{ forloop.Counter }}){% endfor %}]{% endfor %}

name: autoescape
template: {% for e in collections.esc %}{{ e.title }}{% endfor %}

name: filters
template: {% for f in collections.fl %}{{ f.title|upper }}|{{ f.title|lower }}|{{ f.title|capfirst }}{% endfor %}|{{ collections.fl|length }}

name: conditional
template: {% for a in collections.cond %}{{ a.title }}:{% if a.data.featured %}*{% else %}-{% endif %} {% endfor %}

name: draft-excluded
template: {% for d in collections.dr %}{{ d.title }} {% endfor %}
